audited_theorem.value: For every finite tree T with s(T)>=3, m(T)>=F_(s(T)+2).
audited_theorem.equality: Equality holds exactly for duplicate-leaf blowups of P_s corona K1.

forest_independent_set_minimum.basis: Prodinger-Tichy 1982 tree minimum plus elementary bridging of forest components

fixed_support_value.basis: Tian-Tu 2025 mis(T)>=F_(n-alpha+2), n-alpha=nu for trees, and s(T)<=nu(T) for T!=P2

known_ingredients: Prodinger-Tichy path minimum for all independent sets
Tian-Tu 2025 sharp construction contains P_s corona K1 at n=2s, alpha=s
complete_fixed_support_equality_class.bounded_search_note: No exact published only-if classification was located; this is not a novelty claim.

significance.fixed_support_parameter: natural but the numerical extremal value is subsumed by stronger published theory
significance.remaining_structural_value: equality-only sharpening and the core-edgeless support-injection criterion
significance.reason: The value theorem is a direct corollary of Tian-Tu 2025; other main ingredients are classical or explicit in Taletskii-Malyshev, while the unlocated equality-only sharpening is short and elementary.

decision.next_session_recommendation: Keep orders >=15 untouched and the TF4 MIS fan archived; continue TreeForge only from a separately motivated controlled research question.
